metadata.name: bordrless_kit
metadata.description: The Bordrless kit: the token hook a launch installs for the rules it fixes at launch: holder rewards paid in SOL (an exact reward accounting kept in 64 bytes of each holding, claims, and shares streamed over an hour), max wallet until graduation, the creator wallet lock and the early-buyer lock.

docs: Instructions of the kit.

instructions.name: before_burn
docs: Token hook: every burn of a kit mint with holder rewards or the early-buyer lock.

accounts.name: kit_config
docs: The token's config (owner and discriminator checked); its mint is checked in the handler.
Only `init` creates a config, and only at `["kit", mint]`, so this binds it.

accounts.name: reward_vault
docs: for none); address-checked in the handler.

instructions.name: before_transfer
docs: Token hook: every transfer of a kit mint.

accounts.name: kit_config
docs: The token's config (owner and discriminator checked); its mint is checked in the handler.
Only `init` creates a config, and only at `["kit", mint]`, so this binds it.

accounts.name: reward_vault
docs: for none); address-checked in the handler.

instructions.name: claim
docs: A holder claims the rewards it is owed.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The holder: neither the pool nor the launch (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: kit_config
docs: The token's config, with holder rewards on (checked before the vault, which a token
without holder rewards does not have).

accounts.name: mint
docs: `write_hook_data`).

accounts.name: holding
docs: The owner's holding of the token. Holdings exist only at `["holding", mint, owner]`, so
the mint and the owner bind it.

accounts.name: reward_vault
docs: and discriminator checked).

accounts.name: destination
docs: The owner's holding of the reward mint.

instructions.name: graduate
docs: The launch graduated: lifts max wallet. Signed by the kit-caller PDA; once.

accounts.name: kit_caller
docs: The launch program's kit-caller PDA for the config's mint, at the config's stored bump
(checked in the handler).

instructions.name: init
docs: Installs the kit on a launch's mint: creates its `KitConfig`, the reward vault (holder
rewards) and the registry. Signed by the launch program's kit-caller PDA for the mint.

accounts.name: kit_caller
docs: `create_program_address(["kit-caller", mint, [args.kit_caller_bump]], LAUNCH_ID)`, signing
by CPI from the launch program (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent: the creator.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The launch's new mint: the kit as hook with the flags of the modules, no hook authority,
no mint authority, the whole supply minted (checked in the handler).

accounts.name: launch_reserve
docs: The launch's holding of the mint, holding the whole supply.

accounts.name: registry
docs: accepted).

accounts.name: reward_mint
docs: The launch's quote mint: no hook, no hook authority, no freeze authority.

accounts.name: reward_vault
docs: token program; absent (the kit's id) otherwise.

instructions.name: share
docs: Shares `amount` of the reward mint with the holders, released over one hour: the next
one, or the one after the share still streaming.

accounts.name: sharer
docs: Shares from `source`, as its owner or delegate (the token program checks).

accounts.name: kit_config
docs: The token's config, with holder rewards on (checked before the vault).

accounts.name: source
docs: mint, the authority and the balance).

accounts.name: reward_vault
docs: and discriminator checked).

errors.name: BadHookSigner
errors.msg: the callback was not signed by the token program's signer for the kit

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: the kit config or the mint passed is not this token's

errors.name: UnsupportedOperation
errors.msg: the kit answers before_transfer and before_burn only

errors.name: MissingRewardVault
errors.msg: holder rewards are on but the reward vault was not passed

errors.name: WrongRewardVault
errors.msg: the reward vault passed is not the config's

errors.name: DestinationNotAllowed
errors.msg: this token cannot be sent to that owner

errors.name: CreatorLocked
errors.msg: the creator's wallet is locked

errors.name: EarlyLocked
errors.msg: tokens bought in the early window are locked

errors.name: MaxWalletExceeded
errors.msg: the destination would hold more than the max wallet

errors.name: NotKitCaller
errors.msg: not the launch's kit caller for this mint

errors.name: InvalidModules
errors.msg: invalid modules

errors.name: InvalidMaxWallet
errors.msg: invalid max wallet

errors.name: InvalidCreatorLock
errors.msg: invalid creator wallet lock

errors.name: InvalidEarlyLock
errors.msg: invalid early-buyer lock

errors.name: SupplyOutOfBounds
errors.msg: the supply is out of bounds

errors.name: WrongMintSetup
errors.msg: the mint is not set up for the kit (hook, authorities, max supply or flags)

errors.name: WrongReserve
errors.msg: the launch reserve is not the launch's holding of the whole supply

errors.name: BadRewardMint
errors.msg: the reward mint must have no hook, no hook authority and no freeze authority

errors.name: AlreadyGraduated
errors.msg: the kit has already graduated

errors.name: NotAHolder
errors.msg: the pool and the launch earn no holder rewards

errors.name: RewardsOff
errors.msg: holder rewards are off for this token

errors.name: WrongHolding
errors.msg: the holding is not the owner's holding of this token

errors.name: WrongRewardMint
errors.msg: the reward mint passed is not the config's

errors.name: WrongDestination
errors.msg: the destination is not the owner's holding of the reward mint

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: nothing to claim

errors.name: ShareTooSmall
errors.msg: a share must be at least 0.001 SOL

errors.name: NoEligibleHolders
errors.msg: nobody is eligible for holder rewards yet

errors.name: WrongProgram
errors.msg: wrong program account

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: math overflow

types.name: Delta
docs: One cut an answer takes from the amount.

fields.name: amount
docs: How much (above zero).

fields.name: account
docs: Index in the callback's account list (prefix first, then extras) of the holding that
receives it. Must be an extra.

types.name: Holding
docs: A holding: the token account of `owner` for `mint`, at `["holding", mint, owner]`.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump of the PDA.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint.

fields.name: owner
docs: The owner.

fields.name: amount
docs: Balance.

fields.name: delegate
docs: Delegate, if any.

fields.name: delegated_amount
docs: What the delegate may still move.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Frozen holdings cannot send, receive or burn.

fields.name: hook_data
docs: State the mint's hook keeps for this holder (`bordrless_hook::HOOK_DATA_LEN` bytes). Only
the mint's hook program changes it: by answering a `before_*` callback, or through
`write_hook_data`, and only while the mint has `WRITES_HOOK_DATA`. Zero until then.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: HookReturn
docs: What a callback may answer in its return data. Which fields a callback may fill depends on the
callback and the flags ([`Allowed`]); the calling program refuses an answer that fills any
other field.

fields.name: deltas
docs: Cuts from the amount (the transfer; a swap's input before, its output after), at most
[`MAX_DELTAS`].

fields.name: burn
docs: Pool swap callbacks only: an amount to burn from the same side.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: `before_swap` only: the LP fee to apply instead of the pool's.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_burn`): the source holding's new hook data
([`HOOK_DATA_LEN`] bytes).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_mint`): the destination holding's new hook
data.

types.name: KitConfig
docs: The kit's settings and reward accounting for one token, at `["kit", mint]` (`docs/hooks-v2.md`
§4.3). Created only by `init`, which the launch's kit-caller PDA for the mint must sign.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump of `["kit", mint]`.

fields.name: kit_caller_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["kit-caller", mint], LAUNCH_ID)`.

fields.name: modules
docs: Bit set of [`modules`].

fields.name: graduated
docs: Set by `graduate`: max wallet no longer applies.

fields.name: eligible
docs: Sum of the balances of every holding whose owner is not excluded (the pool, the launch).

fields.name: min_eligible
docs: `supply / 1_000` at `init`: rewards are divided only while `eligible` is at least this.

fields.name: mint
docs: The token.

fields.name: launch
docs: The launch (excluded; its reserve only ever sends after `init`).

fields.name: pool
docs: The launch pool (excluded).

fields.name: creator
docs: The creator (the creator wallet lock's wallet).

fields.name: reward_mint
docs: The launch's quote mint (bridged SOL, which has no hook): rewards are paid in it.

fields.name: reward_vault
docs: `holding(reward_mint, kit_config)`; the default key when holder rewards are off.

fields.name: supply_at_init
docs: The supply at `init` (all of it in the launch reserve).

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of `supply_at_init`; 0 when off.

fields.name: max_wallet_amount
docs: `supply_at_init * max_wallet_bps / 10_000`; 0 when off. Fixed: burns never tighten it.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Tokens bought from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: acc_per_share
docs: Rewards per eligible base unit, scaled by [`SCALE`].

fields.name: rem
docs: The scaled remainder of the last division, below the eligible supply it was divided by.

fields.name: held
docs: Lamports waiting while `eligible < min_eligible`.

fields.name: seen
docs: `reward_vault.amount + total_claimed` at the last sync, counting shares as seen when they
arrive.

fields.name: stream_remaining
docs: Lamports of the running stream (the share or shares streaming now) not yet released to
holders. A later share never changes it, nor `stream_last` and `stream_end`.

fields.name: stream_last
docs: The running stream's last release.

fields.name: stream_end
docs: The running stream's end. While nobody is eligible it moves on with the clock.

fields.name: total_distributed
docs: Lamports divided among holders so far.

fields.name: total_claimed
docs: Lamports claimed so far.

fields.name: total_shared
docs: Lamports shared so far.

fields.name: created_at
docs: `init` time.

fields.name: stream_next
docs: Lamports shared while the stream was running, waiting for it: they stream linearly over
the hour after `stream_end`, `[stream_end, stream_end + SHARE_STREAM_SECS]`, and become the
running stream at the first sync after `stream_end`. Taken from `reserved`, so the account
keeps its size and every other field its offset.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: KitGraduated
docs: The launch graduated: max wallet no longer applies.

types.name: KitInitArgs
docs: Arguments of `init`, passed by the launch inside `create_launch` and trusted because its
kit-caller PDA signs; the hard bounds are checked again ([`check_params`]).

fields.name: launch
docs: The launch PDA (excluded owner; holds the whole supply at `init`).

fields.name: pool
docs: The launch pool (excluded owner).

fields.name: creator
docs: The creator.

fields.name: reward_mint
docs: The launch's quote mint, in which rewards are paid.

fields.name: modules
docs: Bit set of [`modules`]: not zero, within `0b1111`.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: `1..=9_999` exactly when max wallet is on, else 0.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: `now < creator_unlock_at <= now + 365 days` exactly when the creator wallet lock is on,
else 0.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: `now < early_window_end < early_unlock_at <= now + 30 days` exactly when the early-buyer
lock is on, else both 0.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: See `early_window_end`.

fields.name: kit_caller_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["kit-caller", mint], LAUNCH_ID)`.

types.name: KitInstalled
docs: The kit was installed on a launch's mint, with every parameter.

fields.name: reward_vault
docs: The default key when holder rewards are off.

types.name: Mint
docs: A mint. Address: any signer at creation (a keypair, or a PDA of the creating program).

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals.

fields.name: supply
docs: Current supply.

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Largest supply ever allowed; 0 means unlimited.

fields.name: mint_authority
docs: May mint; `None` once revoked.

fields.name: freeze_authority
docs: May freeze and thaw holdings; `None` once revoked.

fields.name: hook_authority
docs: May change the hook; `None` locks the hook for ever.

fields.name: metadata_authority
docs: May change the metadata; `None` fixes it for ever.

fields.name: hook_program
docs: The hook program, if any.

fields.name: hook_flags
docs: Which callbacks run (`bordrless_hook::token_flags`).

fields.name: name
docs: Name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol.

fields.name: uri
docs: Metadata URI.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for the creation.

fields.name: hook_signer_bump
docs: Bump of `["hook-authority", hook_program]`, this program's signer of every callback to the
hook (one per hook program, so a hook can tell its own callbacks from a signer another hook
passed on); 0 without a hook. Set with the hook.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: Phase
docs: Before or after the operation.

types.name: RewardsClaimed
docs: A holder claimed rewards.

fields.name: owed_left
docs: What the holder is still owed after this claim (zero unless the vault ran short).

types.name: RewardsShared
docs: Someone shared SOL with the holders; it reaches them over one hour, from now or, while an
earlier share still streams, from when that one ends (`KitConfig.stream_end`).

types.name: TokenHookArgs
docs: Arguments of a token hook callback. Balances and hook data are those of the holdings before
(`Before`) or after (`After`) the operation; `delta` is what the deltas took, known only after.

fields.name: op
docs: The operation.

fields.name: phase
docs: Before or after it.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint.

fields.name: source
docs: Source holding (the mint for a mint).

fields.name: destination
docs: Destination holding (the mint for a burn).

fields.name: source_owner
docs: Owner of the source holding (default for a mint).

fields.name: destination_owner
docs: Owner of the destination holding (default for a burn).

fields.name: authority
docs: Who signed.

fields.name: authority_is_delegate
docs: Whether the signer acted as a delegate rather than the owner.

fields.name: amount
docs: The amount of the operation.

fields.name: delta
docs: The sum of the deltas a `before_transfer` answer took (zero before).

fields.name: source_balance
docs: Source balance.

fields.name: destination_balance
docs: Destination balance.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals of the mint.

fields.name: supply
docs: Supply of the mint.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: The source holding's hook data (zeros for a mint).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: The destination holding's hook data (zeros for a burn).

types.name: TokenOp
docs: What a token hook is being told about.
